question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
WITH customer_prefs AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, 
           MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_pref_styleid,
           MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_pref_styleid
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
entertainer_strengths AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, 
           MAX(CASE WHEN StyleStrength = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_strength_styleid,
           MAX(CASE WHEN StyleStrength = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_strength_styleid
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT ent.EntStageName, cust.CustLastName
FROM customer_prefs cp
JOIN entertainer_strengths es
    ON (cp.first_pref_styleid = es.first_strength_styleid AND cp.second_pref_styleid = es.second_strength_styleid)
    OR (cp.first_pref_styleid = es.second_strength_styleid AND cp.second_pref_styleid = es.first_strength_styleid)
JOIN Entertainers ent ON es.EntertainerID = ent.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers cust ON cp.CustomerID = cust.CustomerID
ORDER BY ent.EntStageName, cust.CustLastName
